assessment.executive_summary: The repository implements a compact customer onboarding service. It accepts onboarding requests, validates customer data, prevents duplicate e-mail addresses, calls an external KYC provider, calculates a risk score, activates low-risk customers or routes risky cases to manual review, persists the customer and publishes an onboarding event.
assessment.system_purpose: Start and track customer onboarding with KYC-based risk assessment and customer status management.

repository_wide_view.summary: The demo repository is a compact onboarding system whose source, contracts, tests, examples and configuration describe one customer onboarding boundary end to end.

source_families.name: Java onboarding runtime
source_families.purpose: Handles REST requests, onboarding orchestration, KYC integration, risk scoring, persistence and event publication.
source_families.business_use: Turns a customer onboarding request into an ACTIVE or MANUAL_REVIEW customer status.

source_families.name: Contracts and examples
source_families.purpose: Documents REST and SOAP surfaces plus human-readable example behavior.
source_families.business_use: Provides request/response context for onboarding clients and integration reviewers.

open_questions: Production authentication, authorization and deployment ownership are not proven by this demo repository.

functional_view.summary: The service lets a client start customer onboarding, checks whether the e-mail is already known, verifies identity through KYC, calculates risk, stores the resulting customer status and lets callers read that status later.
capabilities: Route rejected or high-risk customers to manual review

user_or_system_flows.name: Customer onboarding
user_or_system_flows.description: A POST request is delegated from the controller to the service, checked for duplicate e-mail, sent to KYC, scored, converted into ACTIVE or MANUAL_REVIEW status, persisted and emitted as an onboarding-started event.

user_or_system_flows.name: Status lookup
user_or_system_flows.description: A GET request reads the current customer status through the service and repository.

technical_view.summary: The demo is a Spring-style layered service with REST controller endpoints, a service orchestration layer, repository persistence, an outbound REST KYC client, event publication and OpenAPI/SOAP contract examples.
architecture: OnboardingService orchestrates repository, KYC, risk scoring and event publishing
OpenAPI defines REST schemas and examples

decision_basis.decision_summary: The repository is clear enough to support an onboarding-service understanding report, but readiness decisions should account for the duplicated risk threshold and placeholder tests.

recommended_actions.title: Centralize the risk threshold
recommended_actions.rationale: The service hard-codes 70 while configuration also exposes risk.threshold.

recommended_actions.title: Add executable tests for the named onboarding scenarios
recommended_actions.rationale: The demo names relevant scenario tests but does not assert behavior.

options: Use current code/contracts for a decision-grade demo report
Wait for business-owner confirmation before claiming production policy
tradeoffs.recommendation: Use the report for technical and process decisions, while keeping authentication and owner policy as open questions.

readiness.rationale: Core behavior is visible from code and contracts, but testing and production governance are intentionally light in the demo.

tool_positioning.summary: This pack complements static code scanners by producing an LLM-authored business and architecture narrative from source-backed evidence, while preserving uncertainty as open questions.
strengths_vs_traditional_tools: Connects REST contracts, service logic, KYC integration, persistence and event side effects into one human-readable flow
Keeps file:line evidence attached to management and technical statements
boundaries: The report cannot prove business-owner intent that is absent from code, tests, contracts or docs
The demo does not include authentication or deployment evidence

top_risks.title: Risk threshold is duplicated
top_risks.description: The service uses a hard-coded threshold of 70 while configuration also defines risk.threshold.

top_risks.title: Tests are only placeholders
top_risks.description: The test class names relevant scenarios but does not contain assertions in this demo repository.

recommended_next_steps.title: Move risk threshold into configuration
recommended_next_steps.reason: This prevents divergence between configuration and implementation.

recommended_next_steps.title: Turn scenario tests into executable assertions
recommended_next_steps.reason: The repository already names important test scenarios but the methods are empty.

open_questions: The repository does not show authentication or authorization requirements for the onboarding endpoints.
